population: All five Act 34 Statistics Bureau reservations created in the window; all were closed at capture. No sampling.
exclusions: Pre-Act-34 executions: no meter was active; historical cost remains unavailable, not zero.
Foresight, Strategy and Spying reservations: context only, never part of the Statistics denominator.
Agent exits, commits, reports, mail and readiness signals: process counts, never outcome numerators.
censoring: None for the five Statistics rows at capture: every row is closed with usage present. Future active rows must be charged at the per-run ceiling and marked final_usage_unknown until close; never silently treated as zero.

method.tokens: Sum usage.tokens_total from the frozen reservation rows; source is opencode-service session_v2 absolute-session-total-upper-bound, including input/output/reasoning/cache read/cache write.
method.wall_time: Sum usage.wall_seconds from the same rows.
method.machine_time: Sum usage.cpu_seconds; conservative whole-host busy CPU UPPER_BOUND charged to the office, including unrelated workloads. This is not attributable per-office CPU.
method.verification: Each row hash was read twice and was stable; the five-row sums exactly match aggregate.json by_office.statistics at capture.

hard_cap_units.note: Caps use the same token, wall and whole-host CPU-bound units as the meter. Current lawful authority is Act 34; this record changes no cap or permit.

negative_controls: Other offices' usage is excluded from the Statistics subtotal.
Recorded zero cost is not treated as proof of provider billing; the exact-path zero-billed control is separate Economy evidence.
CPU UPPER_BOUND is never relabelled as measured per-office CPU.
The 2026-11-20 pre-activation comparator remains rejected; no historical resource value is backfilled.

aggregate_at_capture.note: All-office context was mutable at capture and is not the Statistics denominator.

limitations: Token totals are reservation meter snapshots, not independently re-derived from Antonina's source DB in this record.
CPU is a conservative whole-host UPPER_BOUND, not per-office CPU.
Recorded cost 0.0 is not independent provider-billing proof; the separate exact-path zero-billed attestation remains the funding control.
No outcome numerator, causal effect, marginal utility or business-as-usual cost counterfactual is established.
The first row used the superseded 0964bd1e config; the next four used current b80f48af. The non-resettable cumulative debt includes all five.
